channel.title: Midnight blog - en - Last 7 days
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。 | Language: en | Range: Last 7 days

item.title: Why does the later CSS layer lose after adding important?
item.description: Use three buttons to distinguish normal, important and unlayered declarations and plan a bounded layer migration.
